description: This is a Java source file implementing the AccountNumberFormatReadPlatformService interface. It provides methods to retrieve account number format configurations from a database, including fetching all formats, specific formats by ID, and retrieving template configurations for different account types. It employs JDBC for data access, uses Spring annotations, and models data with custom classes and enumerations.

classes.name: AccountNumberFormatReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the AccountNumberFormatReadPlatformService interface. Handles retrieval of account number formats and templates using JDBC with methods for fetching all formats, specific formats by ID, and account type-based templates.

classes.name: AccountNumberFormatMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL ResultSet rows to AccountNumberFormatData objects. Constructs SQL schema for queries.

methods.name: getAllAccountNumberFormats
methods.description: Fetches all account number format records from the database.

methods.name: getAccountNumberFormat
methods.description: Retrieves a specific account number format by its ID. Throws exception if not found.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Provides template account number format data, optionally filtered by a specific entity account type.

methods.name: determinePrefixTypesForAccounts
methods.description: Auxiliary method to determine and set available prefix types for a given account type.
